description: A good end, or not told

participation.context: Answered that he was not told, and went up to write the one line.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Asked after the end, and forbade an invented grief.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Offered the candle and did not stay to read.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You said you had not been told the manner of the end. You did not invent one. You went up with one candle to write the line.
